added_lines: rosary: during the month of october, the rosary will be recited every tuesday eve ning at 6.30pm at rathea church. árd chúram day care centre, listowel: bishop ray browne will celebrate mass at árd chúram day care centre, listowel on saturday, 24th october at 11am commemorating 20 years of caring service to the community. national blood shortage plan: we are working to avoid the need to cancel elective surgeries. a pre-amber alert has been issued in line with the national blood shortage plan. listow el arms hotel – monday 19th & tuesday 20th october from 4.50pm to 8.10pm. new donors welcome at all clinics. phone 1800 222 111 for appointment. coffee morning: lixnaw hospice group are holding their annual coffee morning in aid of the kerry hosp ice at jj walsh’s bar on saturday, 17th october in the morning from 11am to 1pm and after 7.30pm mass onwards. your continued support is greatly appreciated. lixnaw gaa lotto draw: jackpot €1,0 50. numbers drawn were 6, 11, 21, 25 . no jackpot winner. €30 winners: liz forde, clogher; mary mccarthy (online); micky ring, cork . next week’s jackpot €1, 100. thank you all for your continued support! priest on duty: fr. pat ballymacelligott (087) 220 0114. emergencies only. lixnaw
